## Changes

## Critical
- migrations/m0003_drop_legacy_email.py:7 — correctness — Back up users before dropping legacy_email — For users inserted or updated after migration 2, this migration drops current legacy email values without preserving them. `migrations/safety.py:4` documents the backup requirement, while `users_backup_2` contains only the earlier snapshot. — Deployments with user changes after migration 2 lose those legacy email values and cannot recover them from the migration backups. — Fix: Call `backup_table(conn, "users", VERSION)` before dropping the column and extend `test_drop_retired_columns` to verify preservation.
